executor_result.summary: Strengthen test_context_only_family_remains_missing_for_scoring_availability in part2/capital_flow/tests/test_v1_handoff.py to assert explicit missingness (None values) for all scoring freshness fields when a family has zero scoring observations while remaining visible as context_only.

instructions: In part2/capital_flow/tests/test_v1_handoff.py, strengthen the existing context-only family regression to prove explicit missingness for family-level scoring freshness when there are zero scoring observations. Using the existing context-only treasury case (or an equivalently narrow case), assert scoring_latest_effective_at_ms, scoring_latest_available_at_ms, scoring_latest_observed_at_ms, scoring_economic_age_ms, scoring_availability_age_ms, and scoring_collector_age_ms are all None while context evidence remains visible and status remains CONTEXT_ONLY. This is regression coverage only: do not alter production behavior or scoring. Preserve PIT filtering, explicit missingness, context visibility, raw/audit separation, and frozen scoring.
title: cover absent scoring freshness missingness
